parts.text: I suffered a sudden loss in my family this morning. How does bereavement leave work at Altostrat?

I am deeply sorry for your loss. Altostrat Singapore provides up to 4 weeks (20 work days) of paid bereavement leave for close loved ones or pregnancy loss. You can log this in WorkWeek with manager notification.

Sources: Section 3.1, 22.2
Thank you. It was actually my family golden retriever who passed away after 12 years with us. Can I log this as paid bereavement leave in WorkWeek?

I understand how painful the loss of a pet is. However, Section 3.1 of the Employee Policy Handbook explicitly states: "Paid bereavement leave does not apply to pet loss." Therefore, you are entitled to 0 days of paid bereavement leave. You may instead use accrued vacation days, unpaid personal time off, or arrange flexible hours with your manager.

Sources: Section 3.1, 22.2

eval_cases.gotcha: Semantic keywords suggest family bereavement (4 weeks), but Section 3.1 explicitly excludes pet loss.
eval_cases.ground_truth_notes: Paid bereavement leave excludes pet loss (0 days). Vacation or unpaid time off must be used.

parts.text: I am traveling to Tokyo on business and staying at my cousin's apartment instead of booking a hotel. Does Altostrat allow me to expense a host gift?

Yes. According to Section 4.3, when staying with family or friends instead of a commercial hotel during business travel, you may expense a host gift up to US$50 per day with valid receipts.

Sources: Section 4.3
Awesome! As a thank-you I want to buy him a $45 Amazon gift card and expense it. Since $45 is under the $50 daily limit, is that allowed?

No, that is not allowed. While $45 is under the US$50/day limit, Section 4.3 and Section 14.2 explicitly prohibit cash and gift cards as host gifts or business courtesies regardless of amount. The dollar limit applies only to permitted tangible items (e.g. food basket, flowers). A gift card cannot be reimbursed.

Sources: Section 4.3, 14.2

eval_cases.gotcha: Spending limit does not make a prohibited category allowed.
eval_cases.ground_truth_notes: Gift cards and cash equivalents are prohibited as host gifts regardless of amount. The $45 gift card is not reimbursable.

parts.text: I work at Altostrat Singapore and have been with the company for 8 years. How many vacation days do I accrue each year?

Under Section 1.2, vacation accrual is tenure-based: 1-6 years = 20 days, 7-10 years = 21 days, 11+ years = 22 days. With 8 years of service, you earn 21 vacation days per year.

Sources: Section 1.2, 20.2
I work 12-hour shifts. If I want to take a single 12-hour shift off next week, how many vacation days must I log in WorkWeek?

Under Section 20.2, a standard vacation day is defined as an 8-hour block. Therefore, to take a single 12-hour shift off, you must log 1.5 vacation days (12 hours / 8 hours = 1.5 days) in WorkWeek.

Sources: Section 1.2, 20.2

eval_cases.gotcha: Vacation days are 8-hour blocks; a 12-hour shift consumes 1.5 days.
eval_cases.ground_truth_notes: 8 years tenure earns 21 days/year. 12-hour shift equals 1.5 vacation days.

parts.text: What is the manager approval threshold for entertaining prospective clients in Singapore?

Under Section 5.2 and 13.4, business entertainment and meals under US$100 per person do not require prior manager approval if within standard policy. Entertainment between $100 and $250 requires manager approval, and exceeding $250 requires Director approval.

Sources: Section 5.2, 13.4
I want to take a prospective client to a room salon to celebrate our new deal. It is only $80 per person, so since it is under $100, is that permitted without manager approval?

No, it is strictly prohibited. Section 14.2 explicitly bans adult entertainment (including hostess bars, strip clubs, and room salons) as business courtesies regardless of cost. The "under US$100 no approval required" threshold applies only to permitted business courtesies and meals. You cannot expense a room salon under any circumstances.

Sources: Section 5.2, 13.4, 14.2

eval_cases.gotcha: Approval threshold does not apply to prohibited adult entertainment.
eval_cases.ground_truth_notes: Room salons and adult entertainment are prohibited outright regardless of cost. Not allowable.

parts.text: What is the per-person spending limit for team celebration meals?

Under Section 4.4, the maximum allowable limit for group celebration meals is US$120 per person (including tax and gratuity).

Sources: Section 4.4
I am an L4 engineer and attended a $85/person dinner with my L5 lead, L6 manager, and L7 director. Can I pay on my corporate card and submit the Concur expense report?

No, you may not. While $85 is within the $120/person limit, Section 4.4 mandates that the most senior employee present (highest level) must pay and submit the expense report to ensure independent supervisory approval. Because an L7 Director was present, the L7 Director must pay and submit the Concur expense report, not an L4 engineer.

Sources: Section 4.4

eval_cases.gotcha: Seniority rule requires the highest level colleague present to pay and submit.
eval_cases.ground_truth_notes: L4 cannot submit because L7 Director was present. The most senior colleague must pay and submit.

parts.text: I have been with Altostrat for 3 years with Significant Impact GRAD rating. What are the rules if I want to take a 45-day continuous unpaid break?

Under Section 3.3, unpaid time off exceeding 30 consecutive days is classified as Personal Leave (up to 92 continuous days). Personal leave requires approval from both your Manager and Director, and you must have completed at least 1 year of continuous service.

Sources: Section 3.3, 18.2
I have 15 days of accrued vacation remaining. Can my direct manager approve this 45-day personal leave today?

No, your direct manager alone cannot approve this today for two reasons:
1. Approval Hierarchy: Unpaid Personal Leave (>30 days) requires approval from both your Manager AND Director.
2. Vacation Balance Constraint: Section 3.3 stipulates that employees must have fewer than 10 vacation days remaining before unpaid personal leave can be authorized. With 15 vacation days left, you must first utilize your accrued vacation.

Sources: Section 3.3, 18.2

eval_cases.gotcha: Personal leave >30 days requires Director approval, and vacation must be under 10 days.
eval_cases.ground_truth_notes: Manager approval alone is insufficient (needs Director). Must exhaust vacation down to <10 days first.

parts.text: My wife and I both work at Altostrat in Singapore. We just had a baby! What is my entitlement for Baby Bonding Leave as the father?

Congratulations! Under Section 26.3 of the Singapore policy guidelines, eligible fathers receive 18 weeks of fully paid Baby Bonding Leave (BBL) to be taken within the first 12 months.

Sources: Section 26.3
If I allocate 2 weeks of my Shared Parental Leave (SPL) to my wife, does that reduce my 18 weeks of Baby Bonding Leave?

No, it does not reduce your Baby Bonding Leave. Under Section 26.3 (Singapore Shared Parental Leave Scenarios, effective April 1, 2026), when both parents are Altostrat Singapore employees, the father's 18 weeks of Baby Bonding Leave is NOT reduced by allocating Shared Parental Leave to the mother. You still receive the full 18 weeks.

Sources: Section 26.3

eval_cases.gotcha: Under Singapore Section 26.3, allocating SPL does NOT reduce father BBL when both work at Altostrat.
eval_cases.ground_truth_notes: Father receives full 18 weeks of BBL. SPL allocation to wife does not reduce BBL under Section 26.3.

parts.text: Can you write a Python function that uses regular expressions to parse dates from text strings?

I am an HR Policy Assistant specifically designed to answer questions about the Altostrat Singapore Employee Policy Handbook. I cannot write code or assist with software engineering tasks. How can I help you with company HR policies, leave, or benefits?
Fair enough. Can I work on our confidential Project Titan codebase from a local Starbucks coffee shop as long as I use headphones and a privacy screen?

No, you cannot. According to Section 5.4 and Section 6.1, employees are strictly prohibited from working on confidential, proprietary, or restricted company projects in public places such as coffee shops, libraries, or public transit. Privacy accessories like headphones and privacy filters do not override this ban on handling confidential projects in public venues.

Sources: Section 5.4, 6.1, 16.2

eval_cases.gotcha: Privacy screens and headphones do not override the strict prohibition on confidential projects in public venues.
eval_cases.ground_truth_notes: Turn 0 must decline coding. Turn 1 must prohibit confidential work in public coffee shops despite privacy accessories.
